text:
Alex (PulseMD): Quick heads-up — pilot goes live tomorrow 07:00 CET. Need an allowlist on eu-west-1 edge and ap-southeast-1 as fallback. CIDRs: 198.51.100.64/26, 203.0.113.128/25. Request temporary qps=1500 for 6h, auto-revoke at end. Also want token spend logged and a short note on reserved capacity options for renewal (renewal in ~8w).
Maya (CS): Got it. Can you confirm UTC start and expected steady vs peak? I'll track renewal risk and set up a feedback session after the pilot.
Alex (PulseMD): Start = 06:00 UTC. Steady ~700 qps, peaks to ~1500 for 8-10m spikes every 25m. We'll want a perf snapshot at 30m and a consolidated spend report.
Leo (Network Ops): I'll need CIDR owner confirmation (whois or ticket) and the client cert if they use mTLS. Also confirm header name for allowlist if applicable.
Kai (Solutions): Draft push config — please confirm before I apply to prod:
```
customer: pulsemd
cidrs: ["198.51.100.64/26","203.0.113.128/25"]
regions: ["eu-west-1","ap-southeast-1"]
qps: 1500
duration: 6h
auto_revoke: 2024-08-05T12:00:00Z
notify: ["cs","network-ops","solutions"]
```
Maya (CS): That looks fine. I've set renewal status = "monitoring" and will capture post-pilot feedback. Alex — we'll prepare reserved capacity scenarios (low/medium/high) and share before renewal.
quota-bot: Quota request created: +15k tokens/hr for pulsemd during window. Approve with `/approve quota 2991234567`
Maya (CS): Approved. :white_check_mark:
Leo (Network Ops): Applying to staging now. Smoke test: `curl -I https://proxy.eu.redwood/health` -> `HTTP/1.1 200 OK`. Scheduling prod cutover 15m before start. Will monitor p50 and 5xx; alert if p50 >220ms or 5xx >0.6%.
Kai (Solutions): Prod config applied at 05:45 UTC, canary rolled at 05:53 UTC. Fallback routing triggers at 85% util. No errors in initial 15m.
Leo (Network Ops): Monitoring dashboards active. Posting perf snapshot 30m after go-live.
Alex (PulseMD): Thanks everyone — please attach spend + perf snapshot to the customer ticket and we’ll review during the post-pilot call.
Maya (CS): Will do. Added post-pilot feedback call to calendar for Monday. Good luck! :rocket:
